tei:div.tei:p: rta lo zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nyer lnga la/ rol pa chen po'i gtor zlog la zhugs pa'i mtshan thun la rmi lam 'od gsal ma nges par rang snang dpal gyi zhing khams zh-ig na kho bo'i bla ma dam pa bzhugs 'dug pa'i drung du slebs/ byin rlabs zhus snyun dris/ de nas gral gong de nas sdod gsungs/ nan gyis bzlog kyang ma gnang nas gral gong la kho bo mi 'dod bzhin du bsdad/ de nas nyams rtogs kyi bgro gleng phul bas skabs su rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs rgyang glu la drang ba re mdzad nas/ ci yang mi gsung bar mnyam par 'jog yang sngar gyi 'phro rnams gleng nas mthar thug dgyes tshul chen po mdzad nas/ bu de ka de ka yin/nyams rtogs shin tu legs gsungs/ yang kho bos bla ma la lags/ kun mkhyen chen po'i gsang lam ngo sprod kyi gdams pa'i mtshon tshul rnams snga na med pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i gnas yin tshul gyi bsngags brjod 'ga' zhus pa na/ bla ma'i gsung gis/ spyan hur re nga la gzigs nas byang shar mtshams su sdigs mdzub zhig gtad nas/ kun mkhyen chos rje la ngo mtshar che rgyu ci yod/ khyed rang gi bla ma ku ma rā tsa'i rnam thar la ltos/ 'jig rten gyi srung bzlog grong ba'i rkyen sel ci yang mi mdzad/ lung stong gi gzhon nu/ thang stong gi rgyal po/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i chas su bzhugs pa/ sngar gyi bla ma rnams kyi blo skyon gyis phyag chen dang rdzogs chen 'dres nas bshad pa'i gnas mi gsal ba rnams gsal bar byas nas theg mchog 'od gsal snying po'i bstan pa gsal bar mdzad pa la ngo mtshar chen po yod/ nged kyi bla ma dpal sprul pa'i yang bya bral gu yang gi mdzad pa la'ang ngo mtshar che tshul 'ga' gsungs pa ni/ skye phran gzhon nu pho mo gnyis byung nas bla ma ku ma rā dza mjal du 'dong zer nas kho bo'i grogs byas nas song ba na byang shar mtshams/ gnas ngo mtshar mtshar 'dra ba yar stod skyems kyi phu yin snyam pa zhig gi ljongs na thang chung me long 'dra ba zhig na dar dkar gyi gur zhig phub nas bla ma bzhugs pa'i gur 'dab tu sleb pa dang*/

kho bos gsol 'debs kyi dbyangs dang bcas gus phyag gang zhig 'tshal ba na sngar gyi gzhon nu des gur sgo phyes pa na bla ma sku na tshod cher yol sku mdog sngo nag dka' thub kyis shin tu rid pa drang srong gi chas can du bzhugs 'dug pa/ slar bzhengs nas/ kwa ye khyod su yin zhes lan gsum gsungs pa na/ bdag snang ba 'jigs chum pa zhig gi ngang nas ci yang zhu ma spobs nas sngar gyi gzhon nu des 'di skal ldan gyi bu gcig pu ngag gi dbang po'o zhes zhus pa na/ bla ma'i gsung gis/ 'o dus kyis bla chen grags chen chen po go sa nas thob kyi 'tsho ba sdud/ 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi khur gyis non pa mang rabs zhig las/ bya bral gu yangs pa'i sprang po 'di'i dga' yin gsungs/ thugs dgyes tshul chen po yang mdzad pa na/ kho bo yang bag chags ra ri zhig la yar stod skyems kyis phu na bla ma ku ma rā dzas/ bsam yas ngag gi dbang po rjes su bzung*/ 'od gsal snying po rgyud man ngag nyan bshad kyi gdams pa dang bcas pa gnang nas chos 'di'i bdag po khyod yin pas 'gro don gyis/ rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol ba rnams kyis bag chags wal wal yid la dran nas sngar bas shes rab che ba byung snyam/ de nas lho sgo nas byon nas/ ngas gur 'dab 'dir lcags lung zhig bor nas da lam btsal du 'dongs gsungs/ kho bo dang bcas bla ma byang sgor slebs pa dang ma 'ongs lung bstan 'ga' zhig gsungs pa na/ kho bos 'di snyam te/ bla ma dam pa 'di gdod ma'i mgon po dngos su byon pa lags na/ de'i mkhyen gnyis kyis gzigs ngor lcags lung zhig bor dog med/ bor na yang mkhyen gnyis kyi ye shes rgyas pa 'di'i kho bo btsal ba'i grogs la bkug dog med la/ rig 'dzin bla ma dam pa ku ma rā dza mkhyen zhes gsol ba 'debs pas bla ma shar sgo nas nang du byon/ yang kwa ye gsungs/ bla ma dam pa lung rtogs kyi sprul sku zhig sngags rig 'dzin pa'i brgyud pa zam ma chad pa zhig la 'khrungs yod do gsungs/

kho bos bla ma lags/ rjes sa pa yin nam lags zhus pas/ min phyin chad gsal por mngon 'ongs gsungs nas rig 'dzin bla ma dam pa ku ma rā dza mkhyen zhes gsol ba 'debs ngang nas mnal sad pas des nyin la sems skyo ba dang dga' ba 'dres pa smra mi shes pa zhig gis dus 'da' nas skyo bsangs du bris pa'o// 'od gsal rin chen snying po'i dkyil 'khor du// las 'brel rig rtsal rdzogs pa'i dbang thob pa// pad+ma las 'brel rtsal la gsol ba 'debs// 'di phyi bar do gsum du thugs rjes zungs/
/zhes bskul ba po'i ngo ma ldog tsam du chos smra ba'i btsun pa tshul khrims rgya mtshos bris/// /
